title: KARL MAYER - LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
KARL MAYER is a mechanical engineering company that offers a wide range of products and services of its sector with the focus on textile machinery building. The business activities are concentrated on the fields of warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation for weaving. KARL MAYER supports the success of its international customers with products and services that are outstanding in both economic and technical terms, as well as with innovations that move the textile world forward. KARL MAYER has employees all over the world. Thanks to its global organization and its claim to produce in its main markets, the company is always close to its customers and their needs. Today, it has subsidiaries in the USA, India, Italy, Hong Kong, Japan, China, Turkey, India and Switzerland, as well as agencies in all parts of the world. KARL MAYER is a German family-owned company, which has focused on financial independence and economic sustainability since its foundation in 1937. As a permanent, reliable partner with decades of experience and a high level of quality in all areas, it supports the competitiveness of its customers and business partners. title: #85yearskarlmayer #karlmayer #karlmayergroup #anniversary
content: 85 years "growing together" - We start the anniversary year and say thank you! 2022 is a special year for the KARL MAYER Group: in 1937 - 85 years ago - the founder Karl Mayer opened his first workshop in Obertshausen, Hessen. This growth has been made possible above all by KARL MAYER's employees, customers and business partners! That is why, in our anniversary year, we are not only showing the company's development, for example in our anniversary film. Congratulations Karl Mayer, 85 years of great work 🎉🎉🎉.
